_note: 8 scored questions. Each option: main lion +2, secondary lion +1. See docs/personality-quiz.md for full design notes and glossary chips.

questions.title: The Reunion Dinner
questions.prompt: You arrive at the host's home for the reunion dinner. The house is packed and noisy. What do you do first?

options.text: Greet everyone loudly and start organising who sits where
Crack a joke and start teasing the cousins
Slip off to peek in every room and open the snack tins
Find the little kids and grandparents for hugs and catching up
Find a quiet corner and enjoy the chaos from a distance

questions.title: The Hongbao
questions.prompt: Someone hands you a red packet. What's your move?

options.text: Open it right away, no suspense needed
Squeeze it, guess the amount and bet on it
Study the envelope design and ask about the story behind it
Say thank you with a big smile and a warm wish for them
Say thanks politely and save it for something meaningful

questions.title: The Prosperity Toss
questions.prompt: The whole table stands up for the yusheng toss. How do you join in?

options.text: Toss it the highest and shout the loudest wish
Make up silly wishes and get everyone laughing
Poke at the unfamiliar ingredients and ask what each one means
Make sure the little ones and grandparents can reach and join in
Toss quietly while whispering one sincere wish

questions.title: House Visiting
questions.prompt: You're on your fifth house visit of the day. How do you handle it?

options.text: Lead the plan: 'Team, three more houses before dinner!'
Become the life of the party at every house
Enjoy discovering each home's different snacks and stories
Stay for long, warm chats so every host feels appreciated
Have a quiet one-on-one chat with one person, then take a short break

questions.title: The Festive Street Market
questions.prompt: You're walking through the festive lights. What pulls you in first?

options.text: The biggest, loudest attraction, front row please
Game stalls, photo booths and lucky draws
The most unusual stall, to try something you've never tasted
Picking out little gifts for people you love
The calligraphy or lantern riddle corner

questions.title: The Snack Table
questions.prompt: You reach the CNY snack table. What's your style?

options.text: Grab a handful of favourites, decisive and fast
Sneak the last pineapple tart and pretend it wasn't you
Try one of each and ask how it's made
Share your plate with whoever is nearby
Choose one carefully and enjoy every bite slowly

questions.title: The Lion Dance
questions.prompt: The lion dance troupe arrives! Drums pound and cymbals crash. Where are you?

options.text: Right at the front, ready to jump in
Cheering and clapping, hoping the lion picks your hongbao
Creeping close to see how the lion's eyes and mouth work
Holding a little one's hand so they can enjoy it safely
At the side, appreciating the skill and the meaning of the drumbeats

questions.title: The New Year Wish
questions.prompt: It's the start of a brand-new year. What are you wishing for?

options.text: To finally do the big, scary thing I've been putting off
Lots of luck, fun and good times, more of everything
Something completely new: a skill, a place, an adventure
Health and happiness for everyone I love
Clarity, learning and peace of mind
